title: 🛑 STOP WAITING FOR GOD TO SHOUT.
paragraphs: 🛑 STOP WAITING FOR GOD TO SHOUT.
Body: The Holy Spirit doesn’t push—He prompts, and obedience does the rest. 🕊️✨
Too many of us are stuck in neutral, waiting for God to force us into our destiny. We want a billboard, a thunderclap, or a shove from behind. But God doesn’t want robots; He wants relationship.

He speaks in a "still small voice." The prompt is the invitation; your obedience is the key that unlocks the door. If you feel that gentle tug in your spirit today, don't wait for it to make sense to your logic.
Delay is disobedience. Move when He whispers, and watch the mountains move. 🏔️🙌
"I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go... Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle..." — Psalm 32:8-9 (NIV)
Your Move: Type "I'M LISTENING" if you are tuning your heart to His frequency today! 📻👂
